changelog:
CineVerse v3.39.0 (Official Release):
• Instant YouTube Music Engine: Sub-second audio playback powered directly by client-side residential resolution, bypassing YouTube IP blocks
• Continuous Autoplay & Smart Suggestions: Dynamically resolves YouTube related recommendations into the queue without interruption or duplicates
• In-Player Video Mode: Interactive pill switcher (🎵 Audio | 🎬 Video) instantly plays the authentic music video in-frame preserving playback timestamp
• Studio DSP 8D Audio & Sound Effects: Real binaural Haas ITD delay buffer (0.63ms) + 360° circular panning, cascaded sub-bass boost (<110Hz) & treble sparkle, and warm Lo-Fi tape flutter
• Clean Offline Downloads: Pure local file playback with zero network checks in Airplane Mode
• Enhanced Branded Posters: Authentic YouTube high-res artwork with sleek 'CINE MUSIC • LOSSLESS' branding and ambient audio visualizer glow
